Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context

Record Class ContextMenuRegistry.ContextMenuContribution

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context.ContextMenuRegistry.ContextMenuContribution
Record Components:
id - non-blank plugin contribution identity
actionId - non-blank primary plugin action identity
label - non-blank descriptive label
icon - optional icon descriptor
context - non-blank legacy semantic context label
location - non-null typed location
objectKinds - immutable object kinds for selection targeting
priority - deterministic contribution order
target - contribution target
operation - target operation
entry - non-null entry tree
placement - non-null contribution placement
Enclosing interface:
ContextMenuRegistry
public static record ContextMenuRegistry.ContextMenuContribution(String id, String actionId, String label, String icon, String context, ContextMenuRegistry.Location location, Set<ContextMenuRegistry.ObjectKind> objectKinds, int priority, ContextMenuRegistry.Target target, ContextMenuRegistry.Operation operation, ContextMenuRegistry.ContextMenuEntry entry, ContextMenuRegistry.Placement placement) extends Record
Complete declarative context-menu contribution.

For ContextMenuRegistry.Target.SELECTION, ContextMenuRegistry.Operation.ACTION is required and object kinds must be non-empty and legal at location. priority provides deterministic ordering alongside placement; it does not override host ownership or capability admission.
